_spec.purpose: 多益 Part 7 閱讀理解題庫；一題組＝1–3 份文件＋2–5 題；每題 4 選項（1 正解＋3 干擾項），網頁每次作答只洗牌順序。

easy.guide: single 80–150 字／double 200–300／triple 300–420；題幹關鍵字與原文相近；干擾項明顯錯誤

medium.guide: single 150–250／double 280–420／triple 400–580；需同義轉述；1 題推論；整合題比對日期或條件

hard.guide: single 220–350／double 380–520／triple 550–750；多步推論；NOT 依據分散；整合題含更正、衝突或計算；干擾項用原文字詞設陷阱

traps.partial: 只對一半／只看一份文件
traps.wrongdoc: 張冠李戴（用了另一份文件的資訊）

_spec.entry_schema: {id:d{1-7}-{3位數}-{e|m|h}, domain, scene, biz(選填), format:'single'|'double'|'triple', tag, level:{score,cefr,tier,why}, docs:[{kind,label,voice:'F'|'M',read(選填),head:[],body:[](chat以外),messages:[{who,time,t,zh}](chat),speakers:{姓名:'F'|'M'}(chat),table:{header,rows}(選填),zh:[](與body同長),say(選填)}], questions:[{n,type,stem,stem_zh,src:[文件索引],options:[4個{t,zh,ok,trap,why}],evidence:[{doc,quote}],clue:{text(須逐字取自任一文件 head/body 的英文原文片段),steps:[4句]},target(vocab:{doc,word}|intent:{doc,msg}|insert:{doc,sentence,sentence_zh})}], vocab:[{word,ipa,pos,col,zh}], issues(選填)}

rules.order: 題目大致依資訊出現順序；總覽題在第一題；整合題在後半。
rules.options: 每題剛好 4 選項、1 正解；正解用同義轉述不得照抄；至少 1 個干擾項沿用原文字詞但意思不對；結構與長度相近；不用 all of the above。
rules.unique: 每個干擾項代回整份文件都必須明確錯誤，why 寫明原因與 trap；不能有兩個選項同時成立。
rules.evidence: 每題 evidence 至少 1 筆，quote 必須逐字出現在對應文件；整合題至少 2 筆且來自不同文件；notTrue 要列出 3 個有被提到的選項的依據。
rules.clue: clue.text 必須逐字複製自任一文件的 head 或 body（一段英文原文，通常取最關鍵的證據句或片語），不可寫中文說明或自行改寫；解題說明只寫在 clue.steps（剛好 4 句）。
rules.answer_why: 正解選項的 why 必須以「正解：」開頭；4 個選項文字不可重複、長度相近，正解不要總是最長的，也不要與原文連續 6 個以上相同單字。
rules.multi: double、triple 各剛好 5 題，至少 2 題整合題（src 長度≥2），整合題至少 1 個干擾項是只看單一文件會選的答案。
rules.single: 單篇只有 1 份文件：每題 src 只能是 [0]，不可有整合題，且至少要有 1 題 detail（細節題）。
rules.types: intent 只用在 chat；insert 每組最多 1 題且文件需為 ≥4 句散文、含 [1]–[4]；vocab 每組最多 1 題；notTrue 每組最多 1 題。
rules.numbers: 數字、日期、星期、金額要一致，並用程式驗證；全組同一貨幣與 12 小時制。
rules.style: 文件像真實商務文件；公司與人名虛構；email 用 .example；電話用 555-01xx。
rules.biz: biz 為選填，只能是 hr／marketing／finance／manufacturing／it／general；不確定就省略此欄。
rules.dedupe: tag、文件標頭或標題、vocab.word、首句不得與已有題目重複。
rules.uncertain: 不確定的放進 issues；無法達到規格時回傳 {"skip":"原因"}。
rules.output: 輸出單一合法 JSON 陣列（UTF-8、不加程式碼區塊標記）。

level.why: 正解皆為同義轉述；詞彙題是 provided that 的連接詞用法；插入句需用 This 與 that date 的指涉判斷。

docs.label: 電子郵件
head: To: Daniel Ortiz
From: Priya Nair
Date: June 12
Subject: Training Room Booking
body: Dear Mr. Ortiz,

Thank you for contacting the Facilities Department about reserving Training Room B for your team's onboarding session. [1] I am pleased to confirm that the room is available on Tuesday, June 24, from 9:00 A.M. to 3:00 P.M. Our staff will unlock the room at 8:30 A.M. so that your team has time to set up before the session.

The room seats up to 20 people and includes a projector and a video-conferencing system. [2] If you need additional equipment, such as laptops or microphones, please let me know by June 18. [3] Requests received after that date cannot be guaranteed.
Please note that our department does not offer catering. [4] However, you are welcome to arrange for outside food, provided that it is delivered to the loading entrance by 8:30 A.M.
Sincerely,
Priya Nair
Facilities Coordinator, Harlow Logistics
zh: Ortiz 先生您好：
感謝您來信詢問為貴團隊的新人訓練預約 B 訓練教室。我很高興確認該教室在 6 月 24 日星期二上午 9:00 至下午 3:00 可以使用。我們的員工會在上午 8:30 開門，讓您的團隊能在課程開始前完成準備。
教室最多可容納 20 人，並備有投影機與視訊會議系統。如果您需要額外設備，例如筆電或麥克風，請在 6 月 18 日前告知我。在那之後收到的需求無法保證能夠滿足。
請注意，本部門不提供餐飲。不過，歡迎您自行安排外送餐點，只要在上午 8:30 前送到裝卸入口即可。
敬祝順心
Priya Nair
Harlow Logistics 設施協調員

docs.label: 公告
head: Brookfield Community Center
Spring Pottery Workshops
body: Join us this spring for a hands-on pottery workshop led by local artist Helen Cho. No experience is necessary, and all clay and equipment are provided.
Workshops run on Saturdays from April 5 to April 26. Beginners meet at 10:00 A.M.; advanced students meet at 1:00 P.M. Each session lasts two hours.
The fee is $80 for members and $110 for non-members. Register by March 28 to receive a free set of tools. Registrations can be made at the front desk or by e-mail.
Seating is limited to 12 students per class, so early registration is recommended.
zh: 今年春天加入我們，參加由在地藝術家 Helen Cho 帶領的陶藝實作工作坊。不需要任何經驗，所有黏土與設備皆由中心提供。
工作坊於 4 月 5 日至 4 月 26 日每週六舉行。初學者上午 10:00 上課；進階學員下午 1:00 上課。每堂課兩小時。
費用為會員 80 美元、非會員 110 美元。3 月 28 日前報名可獲贈一套免費工具。可至櫃檯或以電子郵件報名。
每班限 12 名學員，建議及早報名。

docs.label: 電子郵件
head: To: All Sales Department Staff
From: Nadia Okafor, Office Operations
Date: Tuesday, October 14
Subject: Corrected Schedule for Sixth-Floor Move
body: Dear colleagues,

This message replaces my notice of October 7 about moving the sales department from the fourth floor to the sixth floor. Because the carpet installers on the sixth floor finished two days ahead of schedule, we are able to move earlier than planned, although several details have changed.

Moving day is now Thursday, October 16, instead of Friday, October 17. Movers will arrive at 7:30 a.m., so please label every box with your name and new desk number and leave it beside your desk by 4:00 p.m. on Wednesday. Boxes without a label will be moved last, and anything left inside a drawer will not be moved at all. IT will disconnect all phones and computers at 5:00 p.m. on Wednesday, and they will be working again on the sixth floor by 9:00 a.m. on Friday.

The earlier desk list, which began with desk 601, is no longer valid because the team has been divided into two sections. Desks 620 through 645, assigned to the staff who handle client calls, are in the east section near the windows. All other desks are in the west section. The updated list is posted on the sixth-floor bulletin board.

Parking passes for the fourth-floor lot remain valid until the end of the month. The freight elevator will be reserved for the movers from 7:30 a.m. to noon on Thursday. If you have any questions, please contact me at extension 5501 before noon on Wednesday.

Best regards,
Nadia Okafor
Office Operations
zh: 各位同仁，
這封信取代我 10 月 7 日關於將業務部從四樓搬到六樓的通知。由於六樓的地毯安裝人員比預定時程提早兩天完工，我們得以比原訂更早搬遷，不過有幾項細節已經更動。
搬遷日現在改為 10 月 16 日星期四，而不是 10 月 17 日星期五。搬家工人上午 7 點 30 分抵達，因此請在星期三下午 4 點前，將每個箱子貼上標籤，寫上您的姓名與新座位編號，並放在座位旁。沒有標籤的箱子最後才搬，留在抽屜裡的東西則完全不會搬。資訊部門會在星期三下午 5 點中斷所有電話與電腦的連線，並預計在星期五上午 9 點前於六樓恢復運作。
先前的座位表（以 601 號座位開頭）已不再有效，因為團隊已被分成兩個區域。620 到 645 號座位分配給處理客戶來電的人員，位於靠窗的東區。其他座位都在西區。更新後的名單已張貼在六樓公布欄。
四樓停車場的停車證在本月底前仍然有效。貨運電梯在星期四上午 7 點 30 分到中午將保留給搬家工人使用。若有任何問題，請在星期三中午前以分機 5501 與我聯絡。

順頌商祺
Nadia Okafor
辦公室營運部

questions.stem_zh: 關於這次搬遷，信中沒有提到下列哪一項？

options.t: Boxes lacking a label will be handled after the others.
options.zh: 沒有標籤的箱子會在其他箱子之後處理。
options.why: 有提到：原文說 Boxes without a label will be moved last。

options.t: Items kept inside a drawer will not be transported.
options.zh: 放在抽屜裡的物品不會被搬運。
options.why: 有提到：原文說 anything left inside a drawer will not be moved at all。

options.t: Parking passes for the old lot stay valid for the rest of the month.
options.zh: 舊停車場的停車證在本月剩餘時間仍有效。
options.why: 有提到：原文說 Parking passes for the fourth-floor lot remain valid until the end of the month。

options.t: Employees may use the freight elevator throughout the moving day.
options.zh: 員工在搬遷日整天都可使用貨運電梯。
options.why: 正解：貨運電梯在星期四上午 7 點 30 分到中午保留給搬家工人，信中並未說員工整天可用。

evidence.quote: Boxes without a label will be moved last
anything left inside a drawer will not be moved at all
Parking passes for the fourth-floor lot remain valid until the end of the month
The freight elevator will be reserved for the movers from 7:30 a.m. to noon on Thursday

clue.text: The freight elevator will be reserved for the movers from 7:30 a.m. to noon on Thursday
steps: 這是 NOT／TRUE 題，要找信中沒有說到的一項。
分別定位標籤箱子、抽屜物品、停車證與貨運電梯的句子。
前三項都能在文中找到對應句，貨運電梯只保留給搬家工人到中午。
代入驗證：說員工整天可用的選項與原文不符，因此選它。

questions.stem: What is suggested about the employee assigned to desk 632?
questions.stem_zh: 關於分配到 632 號座位的員工，信中暗示了什麼？

options.t: The employee works mostly with client calls.
options.zh: 該員工主要處理客戶來電。
options.why: 正解：632 落在 620 到 645 號之間，而這些座位分配給處理客戶來電的人員。

options.t: The employee will move after the labeled boxes.
options.zh: 該員工會在有標籤的箱子之後搬遷。
options.why: 文中沒有提到員工的搬遷順序；順序只與箱子有無標籤有關。

options.t: The employee previously sat at desk 601.
options.zh: 該員工先前坐在 601 號座位。
options.why: 過度推論：601 只是舊座位表的起始號碼，且舊名單已失效，無法推出誰坐過那裡。

options.t: The employee will sit in the west section.
options.why: 與原文相反：620 到 645 號座位在東區，西區是其他座位。

evidence.quote: Desks 620 through 645, assigned to the staff who handle client calls

clue.text: Desks 620 through 645, assigned to the staff who handle client calls
steps: 這是推論題，需要把座位號碼對應到文中的範圍。
定位 Desks 620 through 645 與 staff who handle client calls。
排除沒提到的搬遷順序、過度推論的 601 號舊座位，以及與東區相反的西區。
代入驗證：632 在範圍內，所以該員工屬於處理客戶來電的人員。

items.tag: 園藝中心春季特賣廣告

level.why: 題幹關鍵字與原文相近；營業時間要從表格查；干擾項是其他日期的時間。

docs.label: 廣告
head: Greenleaf Garden Center
Spring Sale — This Weekend Only!
body: Get ready for spring with great savings on plants, pots, and tools. All indoor plants are 20% off from Friday, April 11, through Sunday, April 13.
Spend $50 or more and receive a free watering can. Bring this ad to the checkout counter to get your discount.
Our store is located at 218 Maple Street, next to the Fairview Library. Free parking is available behind the building.
zh: 迎接春天，植物、花盆與工具都有優惠。4 月 11 日星期五至 4 月 13 日星期日，所有室內植物打八折。
消費滿 50 美元即贈免費澆水壺。請攜帶本廣告到結帳櫃檯享有折扣。
本店位於楓樹街 218 號，緊鄰費爾維尤圖書館。建築後方有免費停車位。

questions.stem: What is the purpose of the advertisement?
questions.stem_zh: 這則廣告的目的是什麼？

options.why: 正解：標題 Spring Sale 與內文的折扣都在促銷。

options.t: To announce a new store location
options.why: 廣告只說明店址，沒有說是新店。
沒有任何徵人內容。

options.t: To explain how to care for plants
options.why: 沒有任何照顧植物的說明。

evidence.quote: Spring Sale — This Weekend Only!

steps: 題幹問 purpose，屬於總覽題
廣告看標題：Spring Sale
內文談折扣與贈品，都是促銷
其他選項在文中沒有依據

questions.stem: What must customers do to receive a free watering can?
questions.stem_zh: 顧客必須怎麼做才能獲得免費澆水壺？

options.why: 正解：Spend $50 or more 即 at least $50。
室內植物是打折商品，不是贈品條件。

options.t: Show the ad at the entrance
options.why: 出示廣告是在結帳櫃檯，且用於折扣。
文中沒有提到社團。

evidence.quote: Spend $50 or more and receive a free watering can

steps: 關鍵詞是 free watering can
掃讀找到 watering can，在第二段
前半句：Spend $50 or more
同義轉述：or more → at least

questions.stem: What time does the store close on Sunday?
questions.stem_zh: 這家店星期日幾點打烊？

options.why: 正解：表格中 Sunday 的營業時間到 5:00 P.M.。
這是星期五的打烊時間。
這是星期六的打烊時間。
這是星期日的開門時間。

steps: 關鍵詞是 Sunday 與 close
到表格找 Sunday 那一列
營業時間 10:00 A.M. – 5:00 P.M.，破折號後是打烊
其他時間分別是其他日子或開門時間

items.tag: 倉庫收貨人力協調訊息

level.why: 訊息串需整串脈絡；意圖題的字面義與實際意圖不同；推論題需用「兩個托盤」判斷人力。

messages.t: Marcus, did the supplier confirm Thursday's delivery?
messages.zh: Marcus，供應商確認週四的送貨了嗎？

messages.t: Not yet. They said they'd call back by noon.
messages.zh: 還沒。他們說中午前會回電。

messages.t: OK. The warehouse crew needs a few hours' notice.
messages.zh: 好。倉庫人員需要提前幾個小時通知。

messages.t: Got it. How many people do we need on the dock?
messages.zh: 了解。我們碼頭需要幾個人？

messages.t: Four should be enough, since it's only two pallets of packaging.
messages.zh: 四個人應該夠了，因為只有兩個托盤的包裝材料。

messages.t: Understood. I'll keep my phone close.
messages.zh: 了解。我會把手機放在身邊。

questions.stem: What does Mr. Lee say the supplier will do by noon?
questions.stem_zh: Lee 先生說供應商中午前會做什麼？

options.why: 正解：call back 即再打電話給他。
送貨是週四，不是中午前。
文中沒有提到發票。
文中沒有提到供應商聘人。

evidence.quote: They said they'd call back by noon.

steps: 關鍵詞是 supplier 與 by noon
找到 Lee 先生 10:05 的訊息
They said they'd call back
call back → contact him again

questions.stem: What is suggested about Thursday's delivery?
questions.stem_zh: 關於週四的送貨，文中暗示了什麼？

options.t: It can be handled by a small team.
options.why: 正解：只有兩個托盤，Park 女士認為四個人就夠。

options.t: It has been postponed to next week.
options.why: 沒有任何延期的說法，只是還未確認。
中午是供應商回電的時間，不是送貨時間。

options.t: It contains equipment for the dock.
options.why: 送的是包裝材料，不是設備。

evidence.quote: Four should be enough
it's only two pallets of packaging

steps: 問 suggested，屬於推論題
找貨量與人力：only two pallets
Park 女士說 Four should be enough
推論：量小、四人即可，不需要大團隊

questions.stem: At 10:12 A.M., what does Mr. Lee most likely mean when he writes, “I'll keep my phone close”?
questions.stem_zh: 上午 10:12，Lee 先生寫「I'll keep my phone close」最可能是什麼意思？

options.t: He will be ready to answer the supplier's call.
options.zh: 他會準備好接聽供應商的電話。
options.why: 正解：前文說供應商中午前會回電，他要隨時能接。

options.t: He plans to buy a new phone.
options.why: 文中沒有提到買手機。

options.t: He wants Ms. Park to call the supplier.
options.zh: 他希望 Park 女士打給供應商。
options.why: 是供應商要回電給他。

options.t: He is leaving the office for the day.
options.why: 字面的「放近一點」被過度解讀成離開辦公室。

evidence.quote: They said they'd call back by noon.
I'll keep my phone close.

steps: 引號句是意圖題，不能只看字面
往前找脈絡：供應商中午前會回電
keep my phone close ＝ 隨時能接到電話
字面義與無依據的選項都排除
